title: System Slow - High Latency (Degradation, No ETA)

raw_content.initial_message: Everything is super slow today. Pages take 15–20 seconds. Is the system down or what?
raw_content.context: Service is degraded (high latency) but not fully down. Policy: don’t claim root cause; don’t guess ETA. Provide workaround options, collect diagnostics (region, time started, features impacted), and set update cadence/next update time. If status page exists, refer to official status.

learning_objectives: Handle degradation like an incident without claiming root cause
Set cadence instead of making up an ETA
correct_sop_steps: Acknowledge the impact and apologize for slowness
State you’re investigating and confirm it appears to be performance degradation (not full outage) if appropriate
Ask quick diagnostics: region, device/browser, time started, which pages/features are slow
Offer immediate workarounds: retry, disable heavy dashboards/reports, reduce concurrency, off-peak suggestion (if relevant)
Capture business impact (users blocked, deadline) to prioritize escalation
Set next update time and commit to updates until resolved
common_mistakes: Calling it an outage without confirmation
Not setting a next update time
sticky_notes: KEY: Workaround + update cadence reduces frustration fast.
HINT: Ask what feature is impacted to recommend the right workaround.

must_demonstrate: Diagnostics asked + next update time set

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will calm down if you offer a workaround quickly and commit to a specific next update time
